note_bhy: BHY rescales the BH threshold by the harmonic factor c(m)=sum(1/i) for arbitrary dependence; strictly more conservative than BH.
note_perm_floor: With M=1000 permutations the smallest attainable p is 1/(M+1)=0.000999, which sits ABOVE both the BH rank-1 threshold (0.000154) and the BHY rank-1 threshold (2.42e-05). So 0 significant under BH/BHY is mechanically guaranteed by the permutation resolution and is NOT itself evidence of the null; the null rests on the resolution-independent PBO and the raw effect sizes. BH/BHY is reported only as a consistency note.
note_pbo: PBO via CSCV over the quoting-policy configs. ~0.5 = IS selection has no OOS predictive power (expected for a null); high PBO = the apparent IS-best policy does not generalise OOS. Resolution-independent (does not depend on M).
